description: This file defines the Upload model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to add, delete, retrieve, and list upload records in the database.
external_files: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash Model

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Model class for handling upload records in the database within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database and returns its generated code.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves a specific upload record by its ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an upload record by its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of upload records based on optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Returns the total count of upload records matching optional filters.
